status_boundaries: All dimensions are provisional coordination assumptions.
No coil internals or guaranteed field coverage.
No selected purchased camera, motor, encoder, pneumatic valve or depth device.
No rated capacity, certified safety, load rating or fabrication approval.
Screened 12.5–50 mm does not bound piece height or mass.
Trial design speed and video replay speed are independent quantities.
checks_required: full-width static intake spans, complete outlet projection, branch connectivity and source-solid gate motion
open_design_holds: Induction coil architecture, active standoff and tray height-adjustment mechanism require detailed design. Current assembly provides removable cassette with fixed provisional support geometry.
Complete head/drive nip guarding, access interlocks and safety-function architecture require risk assessment and detailed design. Current covers are concept provisions only.
Nozzle stand-off, angle, manifold and splitter settings require representative fragment trials; available slotted mounts do not prove a validated adjustment range.
Motor, bearing, belt, valve and encoder supplier identities/ratings and manufacturing tolerances remain unselected.
Full-width intake spans and nominal gate contacts are geometric provisions only. Transverse focusing, accepted feed bounds, cone/branch friction, bridging and bounce require physical trials.
Practical gate seals, motion clearance, manufacturing tolerances, wear, thin-piece leakage and jamming remain an unresolved design hold; exact nominal contact is not a working seal.

Moving-particle capture is a design hold. A gravity-only 1.5 m/s horizontal point launch at x=3000, z=1000 mm and y=275 mm crosses the converging cheek at x=3174.64 mm, z=933.51 mm; the wall top is 863.21 mm (about 70 mm below). Existing side guards at y=±525 mm do not collect that interior path. This analytical counterexample is not a measured trial. Intake width does not prove capture. No operating speed or full-width no-jet capture route is approved; all displayed paths and motion speeds are schematic until receiving containment and physical trials resolve this hold.
